questions.question: It was the government that decided to cancel the project, not the company.
options: The decision to cancel the project was made by the government.
The company's decision to cancel the project was influenced by the government.
The company had been planning to cancel the project for months.
The project was cancelled due to a lack of funding.
questions.answer: The decision to cancel the project was made by the government.

questions.question: Unless I finish my work, I won't be able to attend the meeting.
options: If I don't finish my work, I'll miss the meeting.
I will only be able to attend the meeting if I finish my work.
It's unlikely that I'll be able to attend the meeting unless I finish my work.
Unless I finish my work, the project will fail.
questions.answer: If I don't finish my work, I'll miss the meeting.

questions.question: The only thing that surprised me was how well the team worked together.
options: What surprised me most was the way the team communicated with each other.
It was the lack of teamwork that really concerned me.
I was impressed by the team's ability to adapt to new situations.
The team's performance was overshadowed by their poor time management.
questions.answer: What surprised me most was the way the team communicated with each other.

questions.question: Were it not for the rain, we would have gone to the beach.
options: If there hadn't been any rain, we wouldn't have gone to the beach.
We were planning to go to the beach until the rain started.
The rain ruined our plans to go to the beach.
It was the heat that made us decide not to go to the beach.
questions.answer: If there hadn't been any rain, we wouldn't have gone to the beach.

questions.question: What I find most interesting about this book is its ability to make complex ideas accessible to a wide range of readers.
options: The author's use of simple language makes the book difficult to understand.
I found the book's dense writing style to be overwhelming.
The book's main theme is its ability to engage readers from diverse backgrounds.
The author's unique approach to storytelling is what sets this book apart.
questions.answer: The author's unique approach to storytelling is what sets this book apart.
